original.target_description: Big Five Extraversion and job satisfaction; overall bivariate psychometric meta-analysis restricted to Extraversion measures, k = 37 primary studies; Table 8. Input occupational satisfaction/commitment mapped to the article's job satisfaction/organizational commitment; negative emotionality mapped to Neuroticism.

n.sample_role: Total participant sample size across the 37 primary studies contributing to this particular meta-analytic association; not one newly recruited sample. Table note defines N as total sample size in k studies.
n.exclusions: Restricted to Big Five Extraversion/Neuroticism measures (Results, p. 930). Underlying participant exclusions are not documented in this aggregate table; analytic N after individual-study exclusions cannot be independently established.

notes: Published primary article title, authors, year and DOI verified from supplied text first page. Source version: published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service. Table 8 is the supplied p.20 locator. Requested r is extracted as the explicitly printed uncorrected mean correlation Mr̂; the same row separately prints corrected estimated mean population correlation Mρ̂ = .22. No conversion performed.
